E1_HANDHELD_LABEL_MISMATCH.finding: online_candidate.py required strict string 'HANDHELD_USE' while autonomous_phone.py and events.py used 'HANDHELD'. Normalizing to PHONE_USE_CONTEXTS resolved dropped observations.

E2_TEMPORAL_STATE_RESET.finding: ResearchCandidate.push() called self.engine = TemporalEventEngine() on every single unadmitted frame, wiping prior temporal accumulation. Preserving the engine instance restored multi-frame bridging.

E3_TEMPORAL_CONFIG_INCONSISTENCY.finding: TemporalEventEngine defaults (1.2s / 3 obs / 0.55 threshold) differ from calibrated v2 policy in models/temporal_config_v2.json (0.5s / 2 obs / 0.25 threshold).

E4_SUBJECT_SPLIT_FALSE_PASS.finding: validate_isolation() returned 'PASS' when subject_status == 'NOT_PROVABLE' due to 'subject_status != FAIL' logic. Corrected to return NOT_PROVABLE/FAIL.

E5_SAFE_DRIVING_SEMANTICS.finding: UnifiedAnnotation.validate() rejected SAFE_DRIVING whenever phone was visible, even if mounted GPS or passenger phone. Allowed SAFE_DRIVING when phone is non-handheld.

E6_MISSING_E3_FITTED_MODEL.finding: e3_head_scaler was reported as null because no calibrated StandardScaler + OvR logistic head weights were exported into models/active/ or models/candidate/.

E7_MODEL_OUTPUT_SEMANTICS.finding: NumericHead uses uncalibrated OvR sigmoid scores normalized via logaddexp; correctly labeled as UNCALIBRATED.

E8_SAHI_TILED_DETECTOR.finding: On gA-1 s2 frame at 60s, full-frame 640x640 specialist yielded 0 detections, while driver crop auxiliary detected phone at [406.5, 91.9, 446.8, 146.3] near ear.
